data.name: Qabeel
data.gender_notes: Qabeel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A man who is an inviter, a receiver, or someone who is called upon. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'qabala', which means 'to receive'. It is also the name of a prophet in Islamic tradition. The name Qabeel carries the meaning “Inviter, Receiver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qabeel usually hope their child will grow to embody inviter, receiver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the invitation to faith and the reception of divine guidance. It is a name that embodies the essence of hospitality and welcome, making it an excellent choice for those who wish to cultivate these qualities in their children.
data.etymology: Qabeel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Inviter, Receiver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qabeel total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: قابیل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم من اصل Arabic يُشير إلى الجدود و الأجداد
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم قابیل مأخوذ من جذر Arabic القبيل، والذي يُشير إلى الجدود و الأجداد. في الإسلام، يُعتبر قابیل أحد أولاد آدم، حيث كان أول من استخدم الكتابة على صخور و هو يتعلم من الله. يُستخدم اسم قابیل في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر: (وَكَذَلِكَ نُرِي أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ أَنِ يَسْتَحِبُّوا مَآكُلَ اللَّهِ وَيَشْكُرُوا نِعَمَهُ) [الحجر: 32]. يُعتبر اسم قابیل رمزًا للعلم و التدين و الثقافة في الإسلام.

in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम क़ाबील अरबी जذر क़बील से लिया गया है, जो पूर्वजों और पितृपुरुषों से संबंधित है। इस्लामिक परंपराओं के अनुसार, क़ाबील एक महान विद्वान था जिसने कहानियों को लिखने के लिए पत्थरों पर लिखाई थी। नाम क़ाबील के उपयोग के संबंध में कुरआन के हवाले से कहा जाता है कि वह एक महान विद्वान था जिसने अल्लाह की ओर से हिदायत प्राप्त की।

in_english.name: Qabeel
in_english.meaning: Arabic origin name meaning related to ancestors, lineage, and forefathers
in_english.long_meaning: The name Qabeel originates from the Arabic root قَبِيلٌ (qabīl), which refers to ancestors, lineage, and forefathers. In Islamic tradition, Qabeel is known as one of the children of Adam, who was the first to use writing on stones and learn from God. The name Qabeel is mentioned in the Quran in Sura Al-Hajj: (وَكَذَلِكَ نُرِي أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ أَنِ يَسْتَحِبُّوا مَآكُلَ اللَّهِ وَيَشْكُرُوا نِعَمَهُ) [Al-Hajj: 32]. The name Qabeel represents knowledge, devotion, and culture in Islam.
